claim_text: New Earth brings a shared vision into conversation with a developing framework, areas of life, practical projects, research and ways for people to participate.
public_wording_risk: Could be read as a technical integration or complete operating system.
required_action: Describe this as a public relationship model; do not imply system interoperability or live data exchange.
review_notes: The wording uses developing and explanatory language and is not a claim of implementation.

claim_text: The Blueprint offers a structure for exploring that direction and the 12 Pillars connect the framework with major areas of life.
public_wording_risk: Connects could be interpreted as technical linkage rather than information architecture.
required_action: Retain only in the explanatory framework context; do not add technical integration language.
review_notes: The supported evidence is the approved information architecture and content model, not a running integration.

claim_text: Projects explore how ideas might be applied, while the Journal can hold questions, learning and documented progress.
public_wording_risk: May imply operational projects or published evidence in every case.
required_action: Keep project status and evidence labels on later project pages; do not generalise outcomes.
review_notes: The approved wording is cautious and describes content roles rather than project performance.

claim_text: People bring the ecosystem to life through attention, conversation, contribution and careful collaboration.
public_wording_risk: Could imply an active community or formal collaboration network.
required_action: Retain as a principle and invitation; do not claim membership, scale, partnership or outcomes.
review_notes: No external service, account sharing or integration is asserted.

claim_text: The public Command Centre information page can explain purpose and context.
public_wording_risk: The route could be mistaken for an already published or operational public page.
required_action: Keep can explain and public information wording until the website page is separately implemented and validated.
review_notes: The route is in the approved V2 architecture; no implementation exists in this website repository.

claim_text: Private dashboards, operational controls and authenticated applications remain separate protected systems.
public_wording_risk: Could imply independently verified security or deployment controls.
required_action: Retain the separation boundary; do not claim public access, certification, hosting state or security guarantees.
review_notes: Repository architecture and security controls support the boundary, but no live-service verification was performed.

claim_text: This page does not claim technical integration or operational capacity that has not been independently verified.
public_wording_risk: A future edit could remove the disclaimer and overstate capability.
required_action: Preserve this boundary sentence through implementation and specialist review.
review_notes: This is an explicit non-claim and control, not a claim that capability exists.
